name: EvoSchema
description: EvoSchema is a comprehensive benchmark designed to assess and enhance the robustness of text-to-SQL systems under real-world schema changes. It introduces a taxonomy of ten perturbation types simulating dynamic database schema evolution, enabling evaluation of model robustness against schema modifications at both column and table levels.
reputation: A recent benchmark for text-to-SQL robustness under schema evolution, with likely early-stage but relevant interest from the text-to-SQL community.
notes: Focuses on robustness of text-to-SQL models under schema evolution with a novel taxonomy of schema perturbations.
